title: Plant enrichment effects of quantum dots in agroecosystems: a double-edged sword
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00548E, Critical Review
Hao Cheng, Yanxing Xu, Abdelrahman Ibrahim, Yanzheng Gao, Hefei Wang, Ahmed Mosa, Wanting Ling
Quantum dots (QDs) are increasingly used in diverse fields, and thus they inevitably spread unintentionally into the farmland ecosystem through (i) environmental release and (ii) intentional application in fertilizers.
